Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
Flamebait wrote:
>>I play the Ventrue version of this deck in my play group. With Muaziz I
might add. The Ventrue deck tends to work better becauseit gets blocked
more often, and you can Elder Kindred Network any votes you don't like.>>

You know, I run across this far more often than one would think. Apparently,
many people seem to think that the line of text on Elder Kindred Network that
says:

"...if the vote passes, there is no effect."

means that if the vote passes *the vote* has no effect, rather than *the Elder
Kindred Network* has no effect (which is clearly the intent of the card). More
than once in a tournament I have called some vote and had someone across the
table play EKN, thinking that it would nullify the vote if the vote passed. Has
this card been officially clarrified anywhere (or is the VTES wording clearer,
as I haven't actually seen a VTES version)?

LSJ?

Thanks,

Peter D Bakija
PD...@aol.com

Trying is the first step towards failure."
